chapter: Brother Lorenzo Tio Jr. and his career
title: Lorenzo's pupils: Darnell Howard, Simeon, Bigard and others
summary: Russell and Tio list Lorenzo's students including Darnell Howard, Omer Simeon, Tony Giardina, Eddie Cherie, Barney Bigard and Louis Cottrell, and the uncle's pupil Willie Humphrey.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I've met quite a few of his pupils, your brother's pupils up there. People like Darnell Howard studied with him. Yeah. Older Simeon, who was born here, he died last year. Older Simeon, but he was one of the better clarinetists up there. He studied with your brother too.
He turned out a pretty fine little scholar too. And then I tell you, he had a scholar, he had a fellow by the name of Tony Gardina. Oh yes. Gardina.
He was the pupil of your brother's.

That's right. He was a, he had a barbershop here on Liberty in Byron. He, he, he taken lessons from my brother and he was made famous. He went to Chicago and he stayed in Chicago. And also there's Eddie Sherry, he played with the Chicago police band. Remember him? Yeah, he's the one.
Eddie Sherry, he played with the police band. And he was also a scholar, my brother. Barney Begard was a scholar, my brother. Yes, Barney talks about it.

And Simeon too. Simeon and little Elliot Taylor. Oh, he was a good. Yeah. Little Luke of Trell. All of them was his scholars. He had many of them that he turned out, he turned out a lot of white scholars too, but I don't know them so very well. Yeah. And they had Humphrey, Humphrey was a pretty good student also part of my uncle. Which one?
Which, which is the, the young Willie? Willie Humphrey. The young Willie Humphrey. Yeah, yeah, young Willie Humphrey.
